svg.title: The words it learned to trust
svg.desc: Two columns of fifteen words each with their learned coefficient and the number of the 60 training reviews containing them. The most negative are cold at minus 3.2388 in 9, rude at minus 3.2033 in 11, slow at minus 2.3327 in 7 reviews, then mean, terrible, awful, limp, stale, greasy, wrong, bitter, soggy, lumpy, poor, torn. The most positive are hot at plus 2.9625 in 7, fresh at plus 2.8648 in 8, generous at plus 2.4595 in 6 reviews, then quick, delicious, tasty, excellent, lovely, friendly, polite, crisp, perfect, warm, great, fluffy. Three entries are ringed in pink because they rest on a single training review: lumpy, torn, fluffy. rude is in 11 of 60 reviews, which is 18 percent; the ringed words are in 1 of 60, which is 2 percent.
svg.text: The words it learned to trust
the third column is how many of the 60 training
reviews contained that word. rude is in 11 of 60,
which is 18%. The ringed words are in 1 of 60, 2%.
A weight learned from one review is a coincidence.
